reply: Based on the provided documents, treason consists in levying war against them or adhering to their enemies with aid and comfort [3]. No person can be convicted of treason unless there is testimony from two witnesses to the same overt act or a confession in open court [3], though Congress holds the power to declare the punishment for it [3] [2]. While no attainder of treason may work corruption of blood or forfeiture except during the life of the person attainted, all other crimes are subject to different provisions regarding secrecy and witness privileges [3][4]. Additionally, a citizen charged with treason in one state who flees justice must be delivered up by the executive authority of that state to the jurisdictional state [2], though they cannot be discharged from their service or labor just because they escape into another state [2] [5].
